newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Nov 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Nov 6.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on Nov. 6:
WASHINGTON - Nearly two dozen women from across the country are suing securities broker Smith Barney Inc. in the largest class action case of its kind against a major Wall Street investment house.
NEW YORK - Stocks returned to record levels as bond market interest rates fell to a seven-month low.
WASHINGTON - Monorail Inc. of Atlanta is expected to launch a new personal computer priced under $1,000 on the market around Thanksgiving.
WASHINGTON - The Justice Department cleared two multibillion-dollar mergers involving regional phone companies.

PARIS - The proposed sale of giant defense and consumer electronics firm Thomson SA to France's Lagardere may be starting to unravel due to national pride, statism, distrust of foreigners and possibly corruption.
